CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `banking_fraud_agent_src_agent_transactions` (
  `raw` STRING,
  `rec_ts` TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3) METADATA FROM 'timestamp',
  `event_ts` AS COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(CAST(EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'ts', 'Transaction', '$.accountNumber') AS BIGINT), 3), `rec_ts`),
  WATERMARK FOR `event_ts` AS `event_ts` - INTERVAL '5.000' SECOND
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-transactions',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'properties.group.id' = 'agent-banking-fraud-agent',
  'properties.auto.offset.reset' = 'latest',
  'scan.startup.mode' = 'group-offsets',
  'format' = 'raw'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `banking_fraud_agent_src_agent_account_events` (
  `raw` STRING,
  `rec_ts` TIMESTAMP_LTZ(3) METADATA FROM 'timestamp',
  `event_ts` AS COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(CAST(EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'ts', 'AccountEvent', '$.accountNumber') AS BIGINT), 3), `rec_ts`),
  WATERMARK FOR `event_ts` AS `event_ts` - INTERVAL '5.000' SECOND
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-account-events',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'properties.group.id' = 'agent-banking-fraud-agent',
  'properties.auto.offset.reset' = 'latest',
  'scan.startup.mode' = 'group-offsets',
  'format' = 'raw'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW `banking_fraud_agent_in` AS
SELECT
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'entity_id', 'Transaction', '$.accountNumber') AS `entity_id`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'event_type', 'Transaction', '$.accountNumber') AS `event_type`,
  CAST('agent-transactions' AS STRING) AS `source_topic`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'payload', 'Transaction', '$.accountNumber') AS `payload`,
  `event_ts`
FROM `banking_fraud_agent_src_agent_transactions`
UNION ALL
SELECT
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'entity_id', 'AccountEvent', '$.accountNumber') AS `entity_id`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'event_type', 'AccountEvent', '$.accountNumber') AS `event_type`,
  CAST('agent-account-events' AS STRING) AS `source_topic`,
  EVENT_FIELD(`raw`, 'payload', 'AccountEvent', '$.accountNumber') AS `payload`,
  `event_ts`
FROM `banking_fraud_agent_src_agent_account_events`

CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW `banking_fraud_agent_out` AS
SELECT * FROM `event_rule_banking_fraud_agent`(
    events => TABLE `banking_fraud_agent_in` PARTITION BY `entity_id`,
    on_time => DESCRIPTOR(`event_ts`),
    uid => 'agent-processor-banking-fraud-agent')

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `banking_fraud_agent_sink_agent_fraud_alerts` (
  `k` STRING,
  `v` STRING
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-fraud-alerts',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'key.format' = 'raw',
  'key.fields' = 'k',
  'value.format' = 'raw',
  'value.fields-include' = 'EXCEPT_KEY',
  'sink.delivery-guarantee' = 'at-least-once',
  'sink.transactional-id-prefix' = 'banking_fraud_agent_sink_agent_fraud_alerts'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `banking_fraud_agent_sink_agent_banking_errors` (
  `k` STRING,
  `v` STRING
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-banking-errors',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'key.format' = 'raw',
  'key.fields' = 'k',
  'value.format' = 'raw',
  'value.fields-include' = 'EXCEPT_KEY',
  'sink.delivery-guarantee' = 'at-least-once',
  'sink.transactional-id-prefix' = 'banking_fraud_agent_sink_agent_banking_errors'
)

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE `banking_fraud_agent_sink_changelog` (
  `k` STRING,
  `v` STRING
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',
  'topic' = 'agent-account-entity-changelog',
  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'localhost:9092',
  'key.format' = 'raw',
  'key.fields' = 'k',
  'value.format' = 'raw',
  'value.fields-include' = 'EXCEPT_KEY',
  'sink.delivery-guarantee' = 'at-least-once',
  'sink.transactional-id-prefix' = 'banking_fraud_agent_sink_changelog'
)
